features.title: Hunch: fact markets with attested AI arbiter

product_gate.user: reader checking a contested fact (exploit attribution, launch date, crypto claim)
product_gate.buyer: research desk or media outlet wanting fact pages backed by stake, not curators
product_gate.job: know the current best answer to a disputed fact and back it with a stake
product_gate.verb: trade and settle: stake yes/no on a fact; attested AI arbiter resolves; page text follows odds
product_gate.wedge: Illia's wishlist item 1, zero entries in the field
product_gate.direct_alternative: Wikipedia/Grokipedia (no stake), Polymarket (market, no page, human UMA resolution)
product_gate.new_capability: page text written by NEAR AI from live odds; resolution reasoning attested in a TEE and verified on chain via Sworn
product_gate.kill_shot: If no outsider stakes on a page and it reads no better than a Wikipedia stub, KILL
evidence: reply by @NaoXprotocol in that thread asks for an auditable AI arbiter
reply by @mitansh_j07: the idea I'd build first
